verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for a meeting-notes SaaS (e.g., bulk move, delete, export or tag many recordings), but the evidence documents no such capability. It only shows adjacent features: cross-meeting search and pattern analysis via AI Chat or MCP, per-meeting automatic syncing to integrations, and auto-joining scheduled meetings. None of these is an action applied to many selected items at once, so none earns credit.
